description: This script contains database migration and setup functions for support issue priorities, service levels, and agreements in an ERPNext system, including reloading document types and updating related data.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function that reloads document types and calls other setup functions.

methods.name: set_issue_priority
methods.description: Creates Issue Priority records for each priority option in the Issue doctype if they do not already exist.

methods.name: set_priority_for_issue
methods.description: Updates existing Issue records to set their priority field based on current data.

methods.name: set_priorities_service_level
methods.description: Migrates priority-related fields to a child table in Service Level documents, handling missing tables gracefully.

methods.name: set_priorities_service_level_agreement
methods.description: Migrates priority-related fields to a child table in Service Level Agreement documents, handling customer entity assignment.
